QuestInfo.name: Once a Renowned Doctor
QuestInfo.0: It seems #p425# of #m10003007# knows something about a doctor named Niora.
QuestInfo.1: #p425# of #m10003007# told me what she knew. According to her, Niora was once a fairly well-known doctor here in #m10003000#, but one day, after an accident at his hospital took the life of a young girl, he vanished from the city. She said she didn't know where Niora had gone, but suggested I go see #b#p406##k if I wanted to learn more.\n#rOnly characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I went to meet #p406# to try and track down Dr. Niora's whereabouts. I do hope I can get some useful information out of this.

0.0: Dr. Niora, huh... now there's a name I haven't heard in a while. He was a fairly well-known doctor in this city, once upon a time. Skilled enough that he could patch up all sorts of badly injured people, whatever the circumstances. He got more and more famous around the city, made a fortune, and eventually built himself quite the sizable hospital.
0.1: After that, he just kept piling up more wealth and prestige. But then, one day, a young girl being treated at his hospital lost her life — and not long after that, he vanished from the city without a trace.
0.2: That's as much as I know. Where Dr. Niora ended up, I couldn't tell you. Hmph... but #b#p406##k might know something. What do you say? Care to go find her?

yes.0: Well, look at that — seems you're the only one who'd actually stop and help #p412# instead of just walking on by. Guess my instincts were right about you. Heheh...

no.0: Right. Might be better not to go digging any deeper than that.

1.0: Hey, it's #h0#. Huh? You want to know where a doctor named Niora went? Niora... who was that...? Ah! Now I remember! Hmm... If you heard the story from #p425#, I can't pretend I don't know.

npc.0: Dr. Niora was a fairly skilled, well-known doctor in this city, but one day, he just up and disappeared. That's all I know, but a woman who's plugged into everything in this city like #b#p406##k might know more, don't you think?
